name: intraday_trend_channel_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional TWAP algorithms executing large directional baskets create smooth micro-trends at 3-minute resolution — the index moves in an almost-linear ramp as these orders absorb liquidity one 5-second auction at a time. When a 3-minute linear regression channel carries a positive slope and price pulls back to the lower 2-sigma boundary, it signals a temporary deceleration within an ongoing institutional buying program, not a reversal. The regression midline acts as a dynamic magnet: delta-hedging market makers and VWAP-tracking algorithms that are long the micro-trend re-enter when price deviates from the regression fit, creating a 10-15 NIFTY spot point snap-back toward the midline within 30-90 seconds. The symmetric logic applies in downtrend channels — shorts defending the upper boundary get squeezed back to midline as short-covering resumes.

indicators.name: linreg_value_36
indicators.formula: OLS fitted value of close at the current bar using last 36 bars
indicators.purpose: 3-minute regression midline. At 5s bars, 36 bars = 3 minutes — the minimum window to distinguish genuine institutional micro-trend from random noise. Shorter windows (12-24 bars) are too sensitive to individual 5s price spikes; longer windows (120+ bars) capture macro context rather than the micro-trend we're entering. The original used 60 1-min bars (60 minutes) for a 15-45 min hold — scaled proportionally: we hold 30-90s so the relevant lookback is ~3-5x the hold time = 3 minutes.

indicators.name: linreg_slope_36
indicators.formula: OLS beta (points per bar) of close over last 36 bars
indicators.purpose: Trend direction and magnitude. Positive slope with adequate magnitude confirms uptrend channel; negative confirms downtrend. Threshold ~0.10 pts/bar corresponds to ~0.6 pts/5s = ~12 pts/min, a modest but detectable directional NIFTY bias sufficient to sustain a 10-pt midline reversion target.

indicators.name: linreg_std_36
indicators.formula: STDEV of residuals (close - OLS_fit) over last 36 bars
indicators.purpose: Dynamic channel width for 2-sigma bands. Adapts to current realized volatility — in high-VIX sessions channel widens preventing false boundary touches; in low-VIX sessions channel tightens capturing smaller deviations. Replaces fixed Bollinger/Keltner width with regression-specific residual scatter.

indicators.name: channel_position_36
indicators.purpose: Normalized position within channel [0,1]. Entry below 0.15 (lower 15% of channel) for CE and above 0.85 for PE captures the deepest boundary touches where mean-reversion probability is highest.

indicators.name: slope_stable_12
indicators.formula: all(linreg_slope_36 > 0 for last 12 bars) for longs; all(< 0) for shorts
indicators.purpose: 1-minute slope sign consistency. Replaces the original R² > 0.7 channel quality filter — at 5s granularity, requiring 12 consecutive bars (1 minute) of consistent slope sign is simpler and catches the same 'clean trend vs oscillation' distinction. An oscillating slope that flips sign every 10-20 bars indicates a ranging market, not an institutional micro-trend.

conditions: linreg_slope_36 > slope_threshold (uptrend channel with minimum slope magnitude)
slope_stable_12 = True (slope has been positive for entire last 12 bars = 1 minute)
channel_position_36 < 0.15 (near lower boundary — pullback to 2-sigma support)
close >= linreg_lower (not broken through channel floor — thesis still valid)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on a single 5-second bar

conditions: linreg_slope_36 < -slope_threshold (downtrend channel with minimum slope magnitude)
slope_stable_12 = True (slope has been negative for entire last 12 bars = 1 minute)
channel_position_36 > 0.85 (near upper boundary — rejection from 2-sigma resistance)
close <= linreg_upper (not broken through channel ceiling — thesis still valid)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions met simultaneously on a single 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 3 option points (~6 NIFTY spot points at ATM delta ~0.5). If NIFTY breaks through the lower 2-sigma channel boundary by more than 3 spot points, the micro-trend has reversed and the institutional buyer has stepped away. NIFTY 30-second moves average 2-5 option points — a 3-pt stop gives the trade room to breathe while cutting losses before a channel breakdown accelerates.
exit.target_rationale: 5 option points (~10 NIFTY spot points). The regression midline sits ~8-12 spot points above the lower channel boundary in a typical 3-minute NIFTY uptrend. Targeting 10 spot points captures the midline snap-back — the high-confidence portion of the reversion — at 1:1.67 risk-reward, well within the 30-90 second time window.

filters.vix_filter: none — regression channel width adapts dynamically to current realized volatility; separate VIX filter would be redundant
filters.time_filter: no entries before 09:20 (560 min) — need 36-bar warmup; no entries after 15:25 (925 min)
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy at 5s; slope stability filter serves the same channel quality purpose
filters.trend_filter: slope_stable_12: slope sign consistent for last 1 minute ensures we're in a trend, not range
filters.spread_filter: none — limit orders, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-medium — rolling linear regression channels are not a standard retail indicator on 5s Indian index options; institutional TWAP flow creates the micro-trends being exploited, which is structural and persistent

adaptation_notes: Original traded 60-bar 1-min regression (60-minute window) on NIFTY200 individual stocks with 15-45 min holds. Three key adaptations: (1) Lookback compressed from 60 min to 3 min (36 bars × 5s) — proportional to hold time reduction from 30 min to 60 s; (2) R² > 0.7 channel quality filter replaced by slope_stable_12 (1-min slope consistency) — computationally cheaper, directly measures channel stability vs oscillation; (3) Universe changed from NIFTY200 stocks to NIFTY index itself — the same institutional TWAP flow that creates linear trends in large-cap stocks creates smoother, more reliable micro-trends in the index since it aggregates across all constituents. Stop/target recalibrated to NIFTY ATM option points at 30-90s timescale.
weaknesses: Rolling 36-bar OLS regression recomputed every 5s bar is CPU-intensive — O(n × 36) per session but acceptable in numpy; would need vectorized implementation for production
3-minute channel is short enough that a single macro event (RBI bulletin, FII data) can flip slope sign mid-trade, invalidating the channel before the time stop fires
Boundary touches are rare at 5s resolution — in trending sessions price may never reach the 2-sigma band (it overshoots and continues), limiting signal frequency to 3-5 per session
